limitations: Market-by-price snapshots/deltas do not reveal individual order IDs, hidden liquidity, cancellations ahead of us, or exact queue rank.
Aggregate trades reveal aggressor direction, price and total quantity, not the intra-aggregate ordering or matching against our hypothetical orders.
Tape retains the known reconstructed levels/side. Missing quote-price coverage rejects entries; raw multi-level books remain in Parquet.
Recorder application sequence determines causal availability; backwards receive times during snapshot buffering are clamped forward, never sorted to introduce future books.
